units.source_text: 别人闻知此事，也都认为意想不到，大家纷纷谈论。

en.t: When others heard of this, they too found it unexpected, and everyone talked about it excitedly.

units.source_text: 头中将听到这话，想道：“我在色情上也总算无微不至的了，

en.t: When To no Chujo heard this, he thought, "I have been quite thorough in matters of love,

units.source_text: 但老女这门路却不曾想到。”

en.t: but I never thought of taking the path of an old woman."

units.source_text: 他很想看看春心永不消减的模样，便和这内侍私通了。

en.t: He very much wanted to see what it was like for springtime desire never to fade, so he began a secret affair with this Naishi.

units.source_text: 这头中将也是一个矫矫不群的美男子，

en.t: This To no Chujo was also an exceptionally distinguished and handsome man,

units.source_text: 内侍将他来代替那个薄情的源氏公子，也可聊以慰情；

en.t: so the Naishi could take him as a substitute for that heartless Prince Genji and find some comfort for her feelings;

units.source_text: 但她心中恐难免觉得如意郎只有源氏公子一人吧？

en.t: but in her heart, she probably could not help feeling that Prince Genji alone was the man she truly desired.

units.source_text: 欲壑之难填，一至于此乎！

en.t: Can the gulf of desire really be so hard to fill, and come to such a pass?
